book.name: 2 Utasorhonika
book.title: Ubvur Uburhu uwu uvaa aka atsɛnge abi Utasorhonika

content: Ibee ifɛn-Num
Ri imimasha, umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, àka afɛna-Num ru umɛn ugɛ isarhe Uteijee ima itɛ̃rhã ifetem ni iwe ru imor, ru nyaka ngge iki iwe nggu umbi.
Na afɛn-Num ugɛ umɛn ima ishɔɔr ra abok abi amɛn aka abewe, ubinkutsu, asi iwea ubɛn unera awe ru imangmang.
Bɔr Uteijee awe idzidzɛrhe, na awuri idzaanga umbi iker na akaa umbi ru ubok uwuku ubewe ha.
Umɛn iwemɛn ri ikeramɛn ru Uteijee ugɛ umbi aka akorhumbi na awuri idɛ̃ɛ̃mbi ikikorha abinkɛ umɛn iki itsu umbi.
Uteijee ama adarh amɛnmbi ri ibibemu Unum nu ibibimu Ukiristo.
Awu ufang itser itɔ̃
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umɛn itsuka umbi ri itsok Uteijee Uyesu Ukiristo, àka agau atsimbi nggu ubɛn uner uku udɔsa aka awu ughɛrha na asi iseisa ru nyaku ubinkpi umbi aka amesa ru umɛn.
Ubinkutsu umbi nibikambi ahwɛngmbi imɛ̃ngge umbi amesa iwe ru nyaka umɛn. Umɛn ishimɛn ri ighɛrha ivangyɛ umɛn iki iwe nggu umbi,
use umɛn igha ubin unera ni isi ifaimɛn ukpɔ. Umɛn itɛ̃wã utsuu nu atenum, utsur umɛn itsukukumɛn ubɛn unermbi imor.
Umɛn iwemɛn ri ijee iyiki itsu umbi ayika umɛn, bɔr umɛn isi ikũmɛn ngge, ngge itsú umbi amesa ru umɛn na adɔsa.
Ubinkutsu ivangyɛ umɛn iki iwe nggu umbi, umɛn idzaa umbi ikpem iyɛrɛ, <<Unera aba asi itɔ̃ɔ̃ itser, unga asi íghaa ubin.>>
Umɛn igũmɛn ugɛ abɔɔ ru umbi awe ru ighɛrha. Asi itɔ̃mbɔ itser, akpurha anu iyarhe ighɛta azɔki itser abɔɔ.
Ikpũ abɛrɛ ha umɛn itsu umbɔ ni ishɔ̃rhã ri itsok Uteijee Uyesu Ukiristo, umbɔ asei isei uku utɔɔ na atɔ̃ itser abee ubinkpi umbɔ aka igha.
Ru umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, àka niba agũmbi azhe ri ikorhe iyiki ize.
Unera aba asi idɔsunga arherhamɛn ru ubvur uwurɛ, àka angwɛ̃dzɛn nggu unga. Niba awembi nggu unga, ngge itsú unga agũ atsa.
Àka niba anyanga unga awea unggamtsakmbi kata, bɔr àka agbiite atonga ru nyaku ungwɛ̃mbi.
Imimasha ighwe
Uteijee uwu ididɔɔr nibikanga ama adzaa umbi ididɔɔr ubɛn ivang ra atsĩndĩã kishoo. Uteijee ama awe nggu umbi kishoo.
Umum Uburhu, itsɛng ighwe iyɛrɛ ru ubokmum, ngge iwu undzumu utsar ra abvurmum kishoo. Umum iki isaki itsɛng ri iminɛ.
Imimuta Uteijeemɛn Uyesu Ukiristo ima iwe nggu umbi kishoo.
